notes.title: Infamy Leaderboards Are Live!
notes.notes:
[p]The Reach doesn’t hand out trophies - unless you escape with an Artifact, that is. It keeps scars, tall tales, and the kind of grudges you can measure in lightyears. But now, for the first time, prospectors everywhere will have a scoreboard to settle who truly rules the chaos.[/p][p][/p][p]As one of many community requests and pieces of feedback we’ve received and acted on since launch, the more competitive souls amongst you asked for ways to see your Infamy rank. This one was a (relatively) quick win we could act on, so while we're working on other major improvements and additions to the game, here are the new Infamy Leaderboards!
[/p][p]✨ [url="https://leaderboards.playwildgate.com"]leaderboards.playwildgate.com[/url] ✨  [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45556311/4524e4f5970e45664f1dcedcb4d5a86e8885a31f.png"][/img]
New to the Infamy system? It’s Wildgate’s opt-in progression path for the bold. Equip the Infamy Badge in your customization options so that every win adds to your score. But be careful - Every loss will take a little Infamy away. Only those who wear the badge take part, making Infamy a true test for Prospectors who want to prove themselves. You can read more about Infamy [url="https://support-wildgate.dreamhaven.com/hc/en-us/articles/39113969032475-Infamy-System-Overview"]here[/url].
[/p][p][u][b]Inside the Leaderboards[/b][/u][/p][p][/p][list][*][p][b]Sign in with your Dreamhaven account:[/b] Your profile card pops up beside the leaderboard with your Infamy score, title, and rank (if you are in the top 100).[/p][p][/p][/*][*][p][b]See your place:[/b] Your row is highlighted so you can track yourself against the competition.[/p][p][/p][/*][*][p][b]Browse the climb:[/b] View 10, 20, or all 100 rows at a time. Scroll, click, and compare.
[/p][/*][*][p][b]Monthly reset:[/b] Infamy Leaderboards reset on the 1st of each month at 1 AM PDT / 8 AM UTC. Every cycle is a fresh chance to climb.[/p][p][/p][/*][*][p][b]Tiebreakers:[/b] If scores are tied, total XP decides who ranks higher. If that is tied too, the Reach flips a coin.[/p][/*][/list][p]
[/p][p][u][b]Take Your Shot:[/b][/u][/p][p][/p][p]Put on the badge, dive into the Reach, and fight your way up the ranks. Whether you make it to Commodore or claw your way into the Top 100, this is your chance to carve your name into [/p][p]prospector legend.[/p][p][/p][p]The Reach is watching. Let’s see what you’ve got!
[/p]

notes.title: Wildgate - Chinese Launch FAQ
notes.notes:
[p]Hey everyone, [/p][p][/p][p]In a few days time, we’re welcoming a whole new crew of Prospectors to Wildgate![/p][p][/p][p]This coming Tuesday, September 23rd, the Chinese version of Wildgate and its servers will launch. We know news like this often brings up questions about player numbers, matchmaking, content and more. You can find an FAQ covering all the main points below.[/p][p]
While our partner NetEase pushes ahead to bring Wildgate to a new community, our Moonshot team remains fully focused on our roadmap for the coming weeks, months and beyond.

As we shared in our mini-update last week, we’re looking to have a September Dev Update ready for you in the coming days. We’ll discuss what we’ve heard and are taking action on in terms of your feedback, share news on our Roadmap progress, and also some new ideas that we’ve been experimenting with, too…

Until then, 欢迎我们中国船员队友

- The Moonshot Team[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45556311/658ae01135e1be4c00e929101c17700dbd8ddb25.png"][/img][/p][h2][b]FAQS:[/b][/h2][p][/p][p][b]Q: Are servers being shared? What will this launch mean for Wildgate’s Player Count?
[/b][/p][p][b]A: [/b]Wildgate in China will be on separate, dedicated Chinese servers. Players will be able to play both through Steam China, and through our partner Netease’s own client for the game.

We remain committed to work on a Free Trial experience as well as more ways to both bring in new players and excite existing players to return to Wildgate. For more information, [url="https://steamcommunity.com/games/3504780/announcements/detail/530981557607858273"]read our first Dev Update[/url] - we look forward to sharing a second one soon!
[/p][p][img src="data:image/png;base64,"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]Q: Will the launch in China affect the ongoing development of Wildgate?[/b][/p][p][b]A: [/b]Ongoing development and publishing of Wildgate in China will be handled by our partners Netease. Our Moonshot Games team continues to work on Wildgate’s Roadmap as we push forward towards Season 1.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="data:image/png;base64,"][/img][b]

Q: Will there be any differences between Wildgate in China and Wildgate’s global version?[/b][/p][p][b]A: [/b]As our partner in China for Wildgate, NetEase has chosen to develop some specific game features to support the needs of Wildgate’s Chinese community, and may continue to do so in future.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="data:image/png;base64,"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]Q: Will any cosmetics or content that is available in future on Chinese servers come to international servers?
[/b][/p][p][b]A:[/b] Some cosmetic content may be developed specifically for the Chinese community - there are no plans to share this beyond China currently.[/p][p]

notes.title: Dev Update #1: The Road Ahead
notes.notes:
[p]Hey prospectors, [/p][p]
We're now officially a month out from Wildgate’s launch—and it’s been a hell of a ride.[/p][p]
Since Day 1, we've been actively listening to your feedback as well as paying close attention to the health of the game. While we've already implemented some small updates to address key bug fixes and balance changes based on your input and other insights, our work is just getting started.[/p][p]
We’re going to cover a lot in this inaugural dev update, so buckle up![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45556311/658ae01135e1be4c00e929101c17700dbd8ddb25.png"][/img][/p][h2][b]// THE TL;DR[/b][/h2][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"]If you’re busy or just browsing, here are the highlights...[/p][list][*][p]Regional prices adjusted and 34% off Steam sale now live[/p][/*][*][p]Versus AI updates: Now grants XP, two difficulty settings coming soon[/p][/*][*][p]Mid-season patch planned for early Sept—weekly credit quest, balance changes, and more[/p][/*][*][p]More anomalies with better variety are on the way[/p][/*][*][p]Free trial in the works (!!!)[/p][/*][*][p]Player rewards: 1200 credits for Month 1 purchasers + exclusive title for early adopters[/p][/*][*][p]All seasonal Adventure rewards can now be unlocked via gameplay (no more premium track!)[/p][/*][*][p]Season 01 and custom lobbies are still on target for later this year[/p][/*][*][p]Future seasons, new areas of the Reach, and competitive play are on deck for development[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45556311/38ca3ed1bcb8a2ba11f3942e370e40a12682fb5c.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45556311/5efd6a3d581448eea23fa086ad833abfbc00498b.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45556311/38ca3ed1bcb8a2ba11f3942e370e40a12682fb5c.png"][/img]  [/p][p]Still reading? Great! [/p][p]
Below we’ll dig more deeply into the team’s priorities over the next two months, breaking down what’s effective as of today as well as what’s on deck for the next 30 to 60 days. (PS - This is just a snapshot of our work. Our plans can and will evolve as we learn more about what’s best for Wildgate together.)[/p][p]
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45556311/658ae01135e1be4c00e929101c17700dbd8ddb25.png"][/img]  [/p][h2][b] // WHAT'S HAPPENING TODAY[/b][/h2][p align="start"]

🎉 [b]STEAM SALE THIS WEEK[/b][/p][p align="start"]One thing we’ve heard a lot over the past month is that many of you really want to play Wildgate—or, more often, that you really want to play Wildgate with your friends and family. We know not everyone can afford $30 USD right now, so diving into the Reach hasn’t always been easy. [/p][p align="start"]
We want to make that decision easier, and we’d love for you all to expand your crews. Something that we can do immediately to help out here is put Wildgate on sale on our largest platform. So, [b]starting today, the game is 34% off on Steam[/b]—bringing it below $20 USD through August 28.[/p][p align="start"]
[i]To answer the question that some of you are probably asking: We don’t have plans right now to make Wildgate free-to-play. Instead, our current goal / approach is to make the game feel worth its upfront cost for as many players as possible through ongoing updates and content drops. That said, we’ll be doing more sales in the future and, as a team, we’re going to be continually evaluating our price point across all platforms and regions (and will remain open to making further changes as needed to keep the game healthy).
[/i][/p][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45556311/26797848518af633712c33bdf4c8ff1cf6387f44.png"][/img][/p][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"][b]🏷️ REGIONAL PRICE ADJUSTMENTS[/b][/p][p align="start"]Wildgate launched at a price that was too high in certain regions, and we heard the frustration loud and clear. As of this update, prices have been adjusted in most affected countries—including Brazil, Ukraine, Russia, South Africa, as well as several countries in Latin America, MENA, and the Commonwealth of Independent States, and more. We hope that this makes the cost of Wildgate more accessible to more players around the world.
[/p][p align="start"]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45556311/26797848518af633712c33bdf4c8ff1cf6387f44.png"][/img]  [/p][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"][b]☄️ VERSUS AI NOW GRANTS XP[/b][/p][p align="start"]AI mode has been one of the most requested areas for improvement, and we agree it needs to offer more. This mode is something we’re going to continue to work on over the next few months, but as of today’s hotfix you can now earn XP by playing it. It’s a baby step, but one we can take immediately!
[/p][p align="start"]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45556311/26797848518af633712c33bdf4c8ff1cf6387f44.png"][/img]  [/p][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"][b]🎁 NO MORE PREMIUM SEASONAL ADVENTURE TRACK[/b][/p][p align="start"]While this particular change will be relevant later this year, it’s still important to bring up now. [/p][p align="start"]
We’ve talked about this internally for a while, and feedback from players made our decision here crystal clear. Beginning with Season 01, all content included in our seasonal Adventures will be available to everyone at no additional cost. This means no more premium track! You’ll be able to unlock related rewards simply by playing, including both gameplay content (e.g. new prospectors, ships, weapons, and equipment, depending on the season) and a robust suite of cosmetics. [/p][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"](Reminder: Although new Adventures will be added each season, they will not be time-gated. This means that no matter when you may start playing Wildgate, all previous seasonal Adventure content will be available to you to progress through or complete at your discretion.)
[/p][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45556311/26797848518af633712c33bdf4c8ff1cf6387f44.png"][/img]  [/p][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"][b]✨ A TOKEN OF THANKS[/b][/p][p align="start"]If you’ve been with us since launch, thank you for being part of Wildgate’s first steps. As a small gesture of our team’s gratitude, we’ll be adding 1200 credits to your account over the next couple of days. (This one-time grant will be shared with any player who purchased Wildgate before August 21.)


[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45556311/658ae01135e1be4c00e929101c17700dbd8ddb25.png"][/img] [/p][h2][b] // MID-SEASON PATCH (EARLY SEPT)[/b][/h2][p]

🤖 [b]LEARN vs AI + PLAY vs AI[/b][/p][p]As part of our ongoing commitment to improve "Versus AI" in Wildgate, we’re going to be splitting our current mode into two different difficulties: Learn vs AI (easy) and Play vs AI (hard). This should allow you to use Versus AI in a way that can better match your goals—whether that’s building familiarity with the Reach or running a more relaxed co-op session with friends. 
[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45556311/26797848518af633712c33bdf4c8ff1cf6387f44.png"][/img]  [/p][p][/p][p][b]💰 WEEKLY CREDIT QUESTS[/b][/p][p]We’ve seen a lot of feedback around Wildgate’s in-game shop, and we’re taking that to heart. As we’re working out what our longer term plans are for this feature, there’s one specific pain point we want to try to address with a shorter-term solution—that shop content can feel inaccessible to players who don’t have a lot of extra income.[/p][p]
To address this, we’re adding a weekly quest that awards 200 credits on completion.This is ultimately an experiment; our current plan is to have these quests run through the start of Season 01. We want to make sure that we’re able to maintain a healthy in-game economy, so there’s a balance we need to be able to strike here. While we’re finding out what that is (and building out those longer term plans, as noted), we’re happy to give more players the opportunity to access more types of cosmetics. 
[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45556311/26797848518af633712c33bdf4c8ff1cf6387f44.png"][/img]  [/p][p][/p][p][b]🌌 MORE REACH ANOMALIES[/b][/p][p]We’ll be keeping the Reach fresh with a steady flow of new anomalies in the weeks ahead. These anomalies (which currently include but aren’t limited to new objects, hazards, ship loot, POIs, and more) will continue to come online as part of our bi-weekly updates, which drop every other Thursday. Once added, anomalies will remain part of the game's randomization pool. [/p][p]
Based on your feedback, we’ll also be adding MORE anomalies to our bi-weekly updates, as well as adding new types of anomalies to increase the impact these drops can have on your in-game experience. Some bi-weekly updates may have just one anomaly, and others may even have three!
[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45556311/26797848518af633712c33bdf4c8ff1cf6387f44.png"][/img]  [/p][p][/p][p][b]⚖️ ONGOING BALANCE CHANGES[/b][/p][p]We’ll be sure to take advantage of our mid-season patch to continue to balance, tune, and refine our prospectors, weapons, equipment, loot, and more based on your feedback. [/p][p]

[/p][h2][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45556311/658ae01135e1be4c00e929101c17700dbd8ddb25.png"][/img] [/h2][h2][b]// NEXT 60 DAYS[/b][/h2][p align="start"]

🛰️ [b]FREE TRIAL[/b][/p][p align="start"]Not everyone is ready to commit to a game before trying it. To help new players see what Wildgate offers, we’re working on a free trial set to arrive within the next 1-2 months. It will give anyone the chance to explore the world, play matches, and decide if it’s their kind of game. Wildgate is such a unique experience, and we’re excited for more people to discover and hopefully, love it!
[/p][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45556311/26797848518af633712c33bdf4c8ff1cf6387f44.png"][/img]  [/p][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"][b]♻️ LOADOUT CHANGES IN LUCKY DOCKS[/b][/p][p align="start"]This one is pretty straightforward. You’ve asked to be able to change your loadout in the Lucky Docks, so we’re making that happen. This change won’t be able to make our first mid-season patch, so we’ll be adding it to another TBD patch set to land before Season 01.[/p][p align="start"][i]
DID YOU KNOW: When you’re hanging out in the Lucky Docks, that’s actually when the Reach is being procedurally generated for your match!
[/i][/p][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45556311/26797848518af633712c33bdf4c8ff1cf6387f44.png"][/img]  [/p][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"][b]🏅 INFAMY LEADERBOARDS[/b][/p][p align="start"]We know many of you are curious how you stack up against other players. So, we’re building out official Infamy leaderboards so that you can check your ranking at any time. These boards will start as web-based and, if you like them / find them useful, we’ll explore adding them directly into the game client.
[/p][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45556311/26797848518af633712c33bdf4c8ff1cf6387f44.png"][/img]  [/p][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"][b]🚀 EARLY SUPPORTER TITLE[/b][/p][p align="start"]We want to recognize players who stepped in early and showed the willingness to join us from the start. Anyone who purchases Wildgate before October 21, will earn an exclusive title—marking you as one of the first through the gate. While Wildgate will keep moving forward, our OG gatecrashers will always be remembered as the ones who helped us pave the way for space criminals everywhere. [/p][p]

[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45556311/658ae01135e1be4c00e929101c17700dbd8ddb25.png"][/img]  [/p][h2][b] // THE ROAD AHEAD[/b][/h2][p]
As a team of developers, we chose to do something a little ambitious with Wildgate and we know the road ahead will be tough. There’s a lot of competition out there vying for your time, money, and attention, and we have a lot of catching up to do to remain in the ring. [/p][p]
This first month has shown us a lot about where and how Wildgate needs to grow. The updates we’ve laid out here are about adding more to do, making the game easier to jump into with friends, and giving players like you good reasons to stick around. And this is just the beginning, too; while we primarily shared our focus for the next 30-60 days, we’re in this for the long-haul. We’re going to keep building and improving the game, so that each time you return to the Reach, there’s something new and exciting to discover.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45556311/658ae01135e1be4c00e929101c17700dbd8ddb25.png"][/img]  [/p][p]
And there you go…our first dev update![/p][p align="start"]
We’re certain some of the things we’ve shared with you today will change, but what won’t change is our team’s commitment to giving Wildgate—and this community—our full hearts. We look forward to sharing more dev updates in the near future (as well as adding more cool things to our roadmap), and we promise to keep the comms line open.[/p][p align="start"]
As always, thanks for crewing up with us. We’ll see you in the Reach. [/p][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"]-- The Moonshot Dev Team
[/p]

notes.title: Wildgate (PlayStation 5) Review
notes.notes:
I was intrigued by Wildgate when I got a first look at it a few weeks ago. As I’ve gotten older, I’ve started leaning away from online-multiplayer only games, and it’s been a while since I played a big co-op PVP game like Guns of Icarus Online, or, more recently, Sea of Thieves, so I was excited to play a similar kind of game with a more focused direction and some pretty interesting ideas behind it.

Wildgate is something of a mixed bag. At its core, it’s a pretty fun game, and it absolutely nails the fundamentals of a multiplayer experience, but by that same token, every match really depends on both your team and how your opponents choose to play. These look and sound just like a classic “Loot Box” but are not, in fact, Loot Boxes. Every time anyone on your team finds one, you gain an item. The order of the items is fixed and not random. [/i][/p][p][/p][p][b]🆕 SCRAP CRATES[/b][/p][list][*][p]While adventuring in the Reach, players may now find scrap crates in loot rooms![/p][/*][*][p]There are several scrap crates hidden within a match; some crews may not find any crates, some may find one, and other may find multiple[/p][/*][*][p]When located, two things will happen for all members of the crew:[/p][list][*][p]You will each earn 500 XP[/p][/*][*][p]You will each earn a cosmetic that can used after you exit the match [/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]What's In The Box[/p][list][*][p]Please note that scrap crates are not loot boxes; they do not award random items[/p][/*][*][p]There are currently 150 cosmetics that you can unlock from scrap crates, including sprays, fireworks, ship names, audio lines, and prospector, ship, and weapon styles[/p][/*][*][p]The order in which you unlock these is the same for every player[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]NOTE: Even after exhausting the current pool of available scrap crate cosmetics, you’ll continue to earn 500 XP for every crate your crew finds[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][i]// DEV NOTE: We’re also launching with an in-game cosmetics shop to allow more customization of ships, prospectors, and weapons as players venture into the Reach.  The shop is just one of many ways to obtain cosmetics in the game, and we’ll continue to work on this feature based on your feedback. We'll have more to share in upcoming game updates.[/i][/p][p][/p][p][b]🆕 IN-GAME COSMETICS SHOP[/b][/p][list][*][p]An in-game cosmetics shop is now available[/p][list][*][p]This shop will offer a rotating selection of prospector outfits, ship styles, and weapons appearances [/p][/*][*][p]Shop items and bundles will generally rotate every 2 weeks[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]All items within the shop can be unlocked with a new currency, called “credits"[/p][list][*][p]Credits which will be available for purchase with real money[/p][/*][*][p]In-game shop item value will typically range from around $5 to $15 USD (depending on the quality of item and whether or not it’s part of a bundle), and our goal is to make it as easy as possible for players to purchase credits in increments that align with our shop offerings[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]To learn more about the in-game cosmetic shop, [url="https://support-wildgate.dreamhaven.com/hc/en-us/articles/39119907094427-In-Game-Shop-Credits-and-Purchases"]click here[/url][/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45556311/658ae01135e1be4c00e929101c17700dbd8ddb25.png"][/img] [/p][h2][b]🔥 GAME MODES[/b][/h2][p]
[/p][p][b]ARTIFACT HUNT[/b][/p][list][*][p]The Wildgate is now revealed to all crews once it opens[/p][/*][*][p]Time spent in The Lucky Docks decreased to 75s (down from 90s)[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45556311/658ae01135e1be4c00e929101c17700dbd8ddb25.png"][/img]  [/p][p][/p][h2][b]🌌 THE REACH[/b][/h2][p]
[/p][p][b]POINTS OF INTEREST[/b][/p][list][*][p]Monolith entrances can now spawn far away from the Monolith[/p][/*][*][p]Ancient Vault now spawns close to the middle of the map[/p][/*][/list][p]
[b]REACH HAZARDS[/b][/p][list][*][p]Cosmic Storm[/p][list][*][p]Damage to prospectors increased to 10 (was 6)[/p][/*][*][p]Damage to ships increased to 1 (was 0.6)[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]The Reach Queen is now slightly larger than a normal Reach Beast[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45556311/658ae01135e1be4c00e929101c17700dbd8ddb25.png"][/img]    [/p][h2][b]🚀 SHIPS[/b][/h2][p][/p][p][i]// DEV NOTE: We have sped up ship maneuverability a bit to make piloting feel a little better. notes.title: Wildgate system requirements
notes.notes:
Looking at the Wildgate system requirements, this sci-fi Sea of Thieves-like adventure will prove little challenge to your average gaming rig. However, if you've ever set sail in Sea of Thieves, you'll know that the game and its numerous updates can demand a respectable chunk of your existing storage space, which could also happen in Wildgate as time goes by.

You certainly won't need the best gaming PC from our buying guide to get Wildgate running, and it's very likely that the game will perform fairly well on older hardware, considering that the recommended specs call for a graphics card that's over five years old.

notes.title: Wildgate Launch Protocols
notes.notes:
[p]The Wildgate is almost open! [/p][p]
To make sure you're ready for your first official hyperspace hyperjump, we've put together a quick pre-flight checklist. Here's what to expect, how best to prepare, and when you'll be able to dive in and play.[/p][p]
---[/p][p][b]
LAUNCH PREP PROTOCOLS:[/b][/p][list][*][p]How to Purchase ✔️[/p][/*][*][p]Localized Launch Times ✔️[/p][/*][*][p]Reach-Ready Resources ✔️[/p][/*][*][p]Frequently Asked Questions ✔️[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45556311/658ae01135e1be4c00e929101c17700dbd8ddb25.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2][b]HOW TO PURCHASE[/b][/h2][p]
In order to play Wildgate, you will first need to purchase it! [/p][p][/p][p]Players can opt for the [b]Standard Edition[/b] ($29.99 USD) or the [b]Renegade Edition[/b] ($49.99 USD), which includes the Standard Edition plus a variety of themed cosmetics for your prospectors and ships. Can't decide which version suits your vision? No problem! You can always grab the Standard Edition and then upgrade to the Renegade Pack at later time.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45556311/38ca3ed1bcb8a2ba11f3942e370e40a12682fb5c.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45556311/d0009a589502ed4f5d27a766e9adde9df26b925d.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45556311/38ca3ed1bcb8a2ba11f3942e370e40a12682fb5c.png"][/img]  [/p][p][/p][p][b]REMINDER: [/b]Wildgate will become available to purchase once the game is live at 8:00am PDT on July 22. Wishlist early to be notified as soon as our launch bay doors open. 
[/p][p][i]*Prices may vary slightly by region and platform.[/i][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45556311/658ae01135e1be4c00e929101c17700dbd8ddb25.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2][b]LOCALIZED LAUNCH TIMES[/b][/h2][p]
Our plan is for Wildgate to launch across all supported platforms at the same time around the world. What is Wildgate’s launch date and time?
[/b]A. Wildgate launches July 22 at 8:00am PDT.[/p][p][b]
Q. Can I pre-purchase Wildgate?
[/b]A. No. Wildgate will not be available for pre-purchase. As a result, you will only be able to purchase and start playing [i]after[/i] 8:00am PDT on July 22.[/p][p][b]
Q. Can I pre-download Wildgate before it launches?
[/b]A. No. Since Wildgate is a premium game (but is not available for pre-purchase), pre-downloads will not be available. Thankfully, our client is fairly small, coming in at ~9gb!
[/p][p][b]Q. Can I wishlist Wildgate?
[/b]A. Absolutely! You can wishlist Wildgate at any time using the following links:[/p][p][b]
Q. How much will Wildgate cost?[/b]
A. Wildgate will be available for $29.99 USD. (Pricing may vary slightly by region.)[/p][p][b]
Q. Will additional editions of Wildgate be available for purchase?
[/b]A. Yes! Players will have the option to purchase the [url="https://playwildgate.com/en-US/news/renegade-edition/"]Wildgate - Renegade Edition[/url], which includes the full digital game plus a unique bundle of themed outfits and styles for your prospectors and ships.[/p][p][b]
Q. Will the Renegade Edition and Renegade Pack be available on all supported platforms?
[/b]A. Yes! Both SKUs will be available on Steam.[/p][p][b]
Q. How much does the Renegade Pack and Renegade Edition cost?
[/b]A. Players can upgrade to the Renegade Pack for $20.00 USD or purchase the Renegade Edition for $49.99 USD.. (Pricing may vary slightly by region.)[/p][p][b]
Q. What's included in the Renegade Pack?
[/b]A. The Renegade Pack includes:[/p][list][*][p]7 x prospector outfits (Adrian, Ion, Kae, Mophs, Sal, Sammo, and Venture)[/p][/*][*][p]4 x ship styles (Bastion, Hunter, Privateer and Scout)[/p][/*][*][p]1 x helm style[/p][/*][*][p]1 x probe style[/p][/*][*][p]1 x probe station style[/p][/*][*][p]1 x processor style[/p][/*][*][p]1 x reactor style[/p][/*][*][p]1 x turret style[/p][/*][/list][p][b]

Q. Can I purchase the Renegade Pack separately?
[/b]A. Yes! Once you purchase the Standard Edition of Wildgate you can upgrade to the Renegade Pack at any point on your respective platform. [/p][p][b]
Q. Will I need to unlock each prospector and ship before I can use their Renegade skins?
[/b]A. Yes. Before you can equip any Renegade outfits or styles, you will first need to unlock the prospector or ship on which you wish to equip them. Players will start with three prospectors (Adrian, Kae, and Venture) and one ship (the Hunter) unlocked by default; the remaining prospectors and ships can unlocked as rewards by completing different in-game Adventures.[/p][p][b]
Q. What regions will be supported at launch?[/b]
A. North America, South America, Europe, and APAC.[/p][p]
[b]Q. What languages are supported?[/b]
A. English, French, German, Italian, Russian, Castilian Spanish, Latin American Spanish, Brazilian Portuguese, Korean, Japanese, and Simplified Chinese will have both in-game audio and text localization. Traditional Chinese and Ukrainian will have in-game text localization only.[/p][p][b]
Q. Is cross-play supported?[/b]
A. Yes, cross-play is supported.[/p][p][b]
Q. Is cross-progression supported?[/b]
A. Yes, cross-progression is supported; however, a linked Dreamhaven account is required. [/p][p][i]NOTE: Players can download and install Wildgate on all supported platforms; however, your accounts on each of those platforms need to be linked to a Dreamhaven account in order for progress to carry over. We strongly recommend linking your accounts before playing on multiple platforms.[/i][/p][p][b]
Q. What are the post-launch content and monetization plans for Wildgate?
[/b]A. To learn more about our post-launch plans, be sure to check out the latest development map![/p][p][b]
Q. If I participated in a previous playtest, will I need to download a new client?[/b]
A. Yes, you will! Our playtest clients and launch client are entirely separate. [/p][p][b]
Q. What’s changed in the Open Beta from the previous playtest? [/b]
A. Quite a bit! Stay tuned for our full patch notes for details. [/p][p][b]
Q. Will progress from previous playtests carry over into launch?[/b]
A. No. Progress earned from previous Wildgate playtests will not carry over into the live game.[/p][p][b]
Q. Can I play Wildgate offline?[/b]
A. No. Wildgate is an online, match-based game that requires an internet connection.[/p][p][b]
Q. Can I play Wildgate solo?[/b]
A. Wildgate's primary game mode (“Artifact Hunt”) is multiplayer only; however, both our in-game "Tutorial" and "Firing Range" modes can be played solo. If you do not wish to play against other humans, you can also queue up for the "Practice vs. AI" mode (note: this requires at least two players in a crew to play, though four players are recommended).[/p][p][b]
Q. Can I use a controller to play on PC?[/b]
A. Yes! Controllers are fully supported in Wildgate.[/p][p][b]
Q. Can I use a keyboard and mouse to play on console?[/b]
A. No. Keyboard and mouse (KBM) support is not offered on console at this time.[/p][p][b]

A. You are welcome to share game feedback[url="https://discord.gg/playwildgate"] in our Discord server[/url].[/p][p][b]

A. Please [url="https://support-wildgate.dreamhaven.com/hc/en-us/requests/new"]submit a help request[/url] via our Wildgate Player Support portal.[/p][p][b]
Q.  Where can I learn more about the game?[/b]
A.  If this is your first time playing Wildgate, we encourage you to check out the [url="https://support-wildgate.dreamhaven.com/hc/en-us/categories/27354263670683"]Gameplay Guides section[/url] of our Player Support portal. You're also welcome to join our [url="https://discord.gg/playwildgate"]official Discord server[/url] to find more info, ask questions, get support from fellow players, and look for crews.[/p][p][b]

notes.title: CHARTING THE REACH: The Art of Wildgate
notes.notes:
[p]In true Wildgate fashion, the earliest days of development were scrappy and full of exploration. Building something in space was incredible, but it could seem too vast and limitless at times—making it easy to lose your bearings. [/p][p]
So, we chased emotion first, asking the question: [b]What did we want people to feel when they saw our game?[/b][/p][p]
We wanted our game to feel feel warm and lived-in, but not necessarily in a cozy way. Our goal was to build the kind of world that feels ready to welcome you in...then promptly tosses you onto a ship full of weirdos and tells you to figure it out.[/p][p] [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45556311/38ca3ed1bcb8a2ba11f3942e370e40a12682fb5c.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45556311/e566b0c697cee2f98c4313049da76eb79c416b18.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45556311/38ca3ed1bcb8a2ba11f3942e370e40a12682fb5c.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]The visual style of Wildgate began to emerge bit by bit. Eventually, we moved away from raw emotion and our team—this resilient, chaotic, Reach-brained crew—pulled all its various pieces together and wove them into the whole you see today.[/p][p]
In this edition of [b]CHARTING THE REACH[/b], we return to the early days of our art direction: the rules we made, the ideas we tossed, and the moment the world we were talking about started talking back.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45556311/658ae01135e1be4c00e929101c17700dbd8ddb25.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2][b]OUR FIRST LEAP INTO THE REACH[/b][/h2][p][/p][p]Before there were monoliths, mine layers, or salamanders in mech suits, there was [b]Laurel Austin[/b]. As the associate art director, her earliest concepts—like a chunky, orb-shaped probe with too many curious little arms—established the tone of our game immediately: it was salvaged parts, repurposed tech, and brightly lit screens in equal measure. [/p][p][/p][quote][p][i]“In the early stages of developing literal space, you can justify including anything. But we weren't going for sleek, sterile sci-fi. We wanted something that felt homey, but not cozy. More like...someone's been here. Someone's tinkered with this. You get the sense that stories happened here, even if you don't know what they were."[/i] - Laurel[/p][/quote][p][/p][p]These sketches didn't just inspire the visual style of the game; they became the foundational guardrails and guidelines that helped warp the world of Wildgate into something tangible, into someplace where you felt like you could truly belong.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45556311/38ca3ed1bcb8a2ba11f3942e370e40a12682fb5c.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45556311/b80a2b787346b84fb1110865e25cd02ec21896b7.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45556311/38ca3ed1bcb8a2ba11f3942e370e40a12682fb5c.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]But building our game world wasn't just about figuring out the vibes, it was also about understanding how everything functioned. Enter concept artist [b]Sean McNally[/b], who brought in design-based thinking and a love for tech with "just enough logic to be believable." We were now beginning to establish the visual mechanics of Wildgate, and Sean's arrival marked a new chapter in development: one where our art now had to [i]do[/i] things. [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45556311/658ae01135e1be4c00e929101c17700dbd8ddb25.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2][b]THIS SHIP'S GOTTA WORK[/b][/h2][p][/p][p]With Wildgate's plucky, yet dubiously ruthless visual tone taking shape, we turned to how things work—specifically our ships. Silhouettes, turrets, upgrades, and hardware all had to serve gameplay first, while still fitting into our broader patchwork aesthetic. As a result, our focus wasn't on realism, it was on believability.[/p][p][/p][quote][p][i]"You can't just make a ship that looks cool. It has to look like it could do the thing it's supposed to do...and look cool."[/i] - Sean[/p][/quote][p][/p][p]That philosophy carried over into Wildgate's weapons. Rather than standard rifles or pistols, we leaned into repurposed hardware: gear modified or hacked in order to get the job done. [/p][p]
That's how weapons like the Aim-E and Surefire came to life—by starting with a function and layering personality on top. One was inspired by welding tools; another visibly overheats mid-fire. Every detail needed to suggest use.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45556311/38ca3ed1bcb8a2ba11f3942e370e40a12682fb5c.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45556311/fdca23a7b6b072004d2923625661f2b0f98bc25a.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45556311/38ca3ed1bcb8a2ba11f3942e370e40a12682fb5c.png"][/img][/p][p]

As a team, we strongly believe that everything in the game should read well from the first-person perspective [i]and[/i] serve a gameplay purpose—from the biggest ships to the smallest asteroids. So, if something moved, it needed a reason to move, and our art needed to communicate that reason clearly and consistently. [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45556311/658ae01135e1be4c00e929101c17700dbd8ddb25.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2][b]WE DREW A LOT OF ROCKS[/b][/h2][p][/p][p]Outside of ships, Wildgate doesn’t always have a “right way up.” When we committed to full traversal, we meant it— fly, spin, dive, or boost yourself staight into the void, if you want. Our environment design had to shift with that traversal, and we had to make sure every angle was the right one…or wrong one… or both. Who’s to say?[/p][p][/p][quote][p][i]"Wildgate has a really expressive visual language. But we also wanted it to feel tight, purposeful. A place where you trust what you're seeing. In a world where everything is flying, boosting, or trying to kill you, readability matters a lot."[/i] - Laurel[/p][/quote][p][/p][p]To help you find your way in the Reach, we leaned on shape, light, and motion. While big landmarks were given strong outlines and layers to make them stand out, a variety of smaller elements—like fog and drifting debris—were also added to make the world feel more alive and easier to navigate. [/p][p]
A lot of work went into these more miniscule materials that players might not ever notice. Whether its rocks or clouds, we knew they not only had to look good from all directions, but they also had to say—"Hey, there’s something over here!"[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45556311/38ca3ed1bcb8a2ba11f3942e370e40a12682fb5c.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45556311/baf8ab754a1a02977eb1473ccf653499166d465e.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45556311/38ca3ed1bcb8a2ba11f3942e370e40a12682fb5c.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Visual friction also became a tool for us, as well! [/p][p]
For example: space dust can help you feel your velocity. Thanks to these precious little particles, you can tell how fast you’re moving through space (like when your crewmate sets off the clamp jet they’ve just attached to you). [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45556311/658ae01135e1be4c00e929101c17700dbd8ddb25.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2][b]ENTER: PROSPECTORS[/b][/h2][p][/p][p]Once the world started taking shape, it was time to fill it—with life![/p][p]
When it came to Wildgate's characters (a.k.a. "prospectors"), we wanted a lot of visual variety. From tall, burly aliens to sleek, agile humanoids, creating an ecosystem whose inhabitants felt robust was critical, and physical diversity was a big focus. We took inspiration from nature, science, literature, even our favorite Saturday morning cartoons, and more.[/p][p][/p][quote][p][i]“We knew we wanted humans, though we weren’t sure how many or exactly what direction we’d take. We leaned into a strong variety of elements. You’ll notice familiar echoes in some of the designs, like little nods to the kinds of characters I grew up with within the sci-fi and fantasy worlds of the ’80s and ’90s. There’s a lot of nostalgic charm baked into their designs.”[/i] - Laurel[/p][/quote][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45556311/38ca3ed1bcb8a2ba11f3942e370e40a12682fb5c.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45556311/b2fcba3566fdde5a8e9665a1d8e4403bb46d6470.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45556311/f5da6e7a0baaa9c5be1fd80cd52daf69ddb371e9.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45556311/38ca3ed1bcb8a2ba11f3942e370e40a12682fb5c.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Since we first started experimenting with our prospectors, our art and design teams have remained in a constant, yet elegant tango—especially in the concepting phases where nothing was set in stone. Abilities, weapons, movement? Initially, everything was fluid and always changing.[/p][p]
What didn't change, though, was our team's shared approach and end goal. [/p][p]
In Wildgate, we like to say that "personality doesn’t equal preset," so the big balancing act was making sure each prospector could stand out visually without locking players into rigid in-game roles. While we wanted our designs to spark community curiosity, we didn't want them to dictate how they had to be played.  [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45556311/658ae01135e1be4c00e929101c17700dbd8ddb25.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2][b]THE RIGHT KIND OF WRONG[/b][/h2][p][/p][p]Prospectors aren’t just eye candy, though—they're extensions of game's tone and feel.[/p][p]
Although Wildgate is dangerous and has high-stakes, it's not oppressive or bleak. Our prospectors are similar contradictions in motion. They're both clever and clueless, enterprising and endearing, and sometimes they're all those things all at once. Full of contrast sharp enough to cut through the Reach, with a visual style to match.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45556311/38ca3ed1bcb8a2ba11f3942e370e40a12682fb5c.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45556311/40e2e2fc1a170fbf8d5e19c3a2a1810b9d72aec3.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45556311/38ca3ed1bcb8a2ba11f3942e370e40a12682fb5c.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][quote][p][i]“It’s a ruthless game, if you think about it. But we leaned into visual warmth, humor, and weirdness, not as a mask for the game’s brutality, but as a way to make it more human. If we went full hardcore sci-fi, it just wouldn’t work. It would be too mean. We wanted something closer to the meanness we reserve for our closest friends.”[/i] - Sean[/p][/quote][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45556311/38ca3ed1bcb8a2ba11f3942e370e40a12682fb5c.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45556311/e1dba91f92c8991b4aebb5171bf8b7eb04bfe139.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45556311/38ca3ed1bcb8a2ba11f3942e370e40a12682fb5c.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][quote][p][i]“I’ve made some really violent art in my career, but there’s something so fun about living in a world where even when things go terribly wrong, it’s a cute, sneaky little bug-bird-pterosaur-deer guy pulling the trigger.”[/i] - Laurel[/p][/quote][p][/p][p]That balance of violence and whimsy, tension and charm, became one of our team’s signatures. It reflects the game and who we are as a team. We may be some of the kindest people you’ll meet, and yet… we’re absolute villains in-game. That contrast is essential to what we’re building, and informs our decisions from the very first pixel to final render. 
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45556311/658ae01135e1be4c00e929101c17700dbd8ddb25.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]WELCOME TO THE LUCKY DOCKS[/h2][p][/p][p]For years, Wildgate lived exclusively inside the minds of our Moonshot teammates; it was a strange, beautiful little game built on shared trust and endless imagination. From an artist's perspective, it feels rare to be able to craft something original, from scratch, with this kind of freedom—and that gift isn't something we take for granted. [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45556311/38ca3ed1bcb8a2ba11f3942e370e40a12682fb5c.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45556311/60035789dcaf69e99f1baf5c6561c727f56ceb39.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45556311/38ca3ed1bcb8a2ba11f3942e370e40a12682fb5c.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]We've poured our heart, souls, and passions into this project...and now, it belongs to you![/p][p]
And if you’ve made it this far—through axolotls and mech suits, tools and turrets, rocks and cosmic storms—then you’re one of us now! So, choose your ship, prepare your loadouts, and always remember that the only plan that matters is the one you make up on the fly. We hope to see you gate-side.  [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45556311/658ae01135e1be4c00e929101c17700dbd8ddb25.png"][/img][/p][p][b]

notes.title: CRASH COURSE: The Loot
notes.notes:
[p]Welcome to your CRASH COURSE on [b]The Loot[/b].[/p][p][/p][p]In Wildgate, loot isn’t just about shiny things. From hardpoints that make your ammo go [i]BRRR! [/i]to ancient weapons that whisper "[i]maybe don’t give this to Mophs[/i]," the items you find (or steal) can have a big impact on your in-game experience. They can affect the survival of your ship, the size and type of explosions you bring to the Reach, how quickly you can get from Point A to Point "SEE YA," and more...[/p][p][/p][p]Can't tell a hardpoint from a handheld? Let's crack open a few loot rooms and see what's inside!
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45556311/658ae01135e1be4c00e929101c17700dbd8ddb25.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2][b]BEFORE WE DIVE IN...[/b][/h2][p][/p][p]As a reminder: When you first enter the Reach with your crew, the only things you bring with you are your prospectors, the weapons and equipment you select as part of your loadout, and your ship. [/p][p][/p][p]To increase your chances of success, you'll want to locate upgrades (known in Wildgate as[b] loot[/b]). [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45556311/97e0b26062b68ddd369debae554bb47c5657bbc3.jpg"][/img]  [/p][p]Loot can found in appropriately-named loot rooms, which will open after completing Points of Interest. The types of loot you can find in the Reach fall into three categories:
[/p][list][*][p][b]CANNONS[/b] - Cannons are your ship's guns. Before they can be used, cannons must be mounted into turrets, which are located in various locations around your ship. Different ship types can support different quantities of cannons. [/p][p][/p][/*][*][p][b]HARDPOINTS [/b]- Hardpoints provide additional tactical bonuses and capabilities for your ship. Similar to cannons, hardpoints must be installed into designated placements across your ship's hull before their benefits kick in. 
[/p][/*][*][p][b]GADGETS[/b] - These are handheld devices that usually are one-time use or have a limited duration. They can range from weapons to utilitarian trinkets. [/p][/*][/list][p]
  [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45556311/26797848518af633712c33bdf4c8ff1cf6387f44.png"][/img]  [/p][p][/p][h2][b]CANNONS:[/b] BOOM, SHAKE THE ROOM[/h2][p]
At the start of every match, you'll find standard [b]cannons[/b] equipped in each of your ship's turrets. [/p][p][/p][p]These cannons are servicable, but ultimately simple. Functional, but pretty flavorless! Thankfully, there's a variety of weapons-grade upgrades just waiting to be rescued in the Reach. [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45556311/9f62f8aafa796b06cca0e4797f568df41ca41a56.jpg"][/img]    [/p][p]Here are some examples of cannons you can find:
[/p][list][*][p]Long-range? The [b]SNIPER CANNON[/b] hits hard and tactically.
[/p][/*][*][p]Up close? [b]SCATTER CANNONS[/b] or[b] THERMAL CANNONS[/b] will turn ships and shields into scrap.
[/p][/*][*][p]Need space? The [b]MACRO CANNON[/b] knocks enemies back like a Lucky Docks bouncer on a Friday night.
[/p][/*][*][p]If you’re super lucky, you may even find an [b]ENTROPY CANNON[/b]. Congratulations! You’re now a problem—perhaps the problem. (Just make sure someone doesn’t decide it’d look better on their ship instead of yours.)[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45556311/26797848518af633712c33bdf4c8ff1cf6387f44.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2][b]HARDPOINTS: [/b]TACTICAL TREATS[/h2][p][/p][p]While [b]hardpoints[/b] technically all come in the same shape and size, their greatly varies![/p][p][/p][p]Some hardpoints are passive, conveying persistent benefits as soon as they're installed in your ship's hull, while others require you or your crew to activate their primary ability—usually by pushing a big, bright red button. Some are defensive in nature, boosting your shields or resources for example, while others (you guessed it) provide more offensive functionality focused on sowing chaos and space crimes in equal measure.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45556311/497c638ea1f646520e8b3fe00ca31a1f833f5ab7.jpg"][/img]  [/p][p]Here are some examples of hardpoints you can find:[/p][p][/p][list][*][p][b]AMMO REGEN[/b] - Enables passive regeneration of ship ammo for cannons. 
[/p][/*][*][p][b]SHOCK FIELD[/b] - Temporarily wraps your ship in electrical energy that does more than just tickle rival boarders. Perfect for crews who enjoy setting "healthy" boundaries.
[/p][/*][*][p][b]PROBE SENSOR[/b] - Amplifies your probe scan range, which means you might get info earlier than anyone else (including but not limited to the location of rival ships).
 [/p][/*][*][p][b]SMUGGLER'S TURN[/b] - Boosts your ship's rotation speed and lets you drift like a true Lucky Docks SpeedStar. Punch it, Sammo! (rawwwwrawrwarawll)
[/p][/*][*][p][b]LASER RAM[/b] - Projects a short-range beam from the hull of your ship that converts enemy hulls into deep-fried. plasma-glazed regret.
[/p][/*][*][p][b]MINE LAYER [/b]- Dumps collision-activated explosives into space, which can be great for both defensive and offensive strategies. Just be careful not to run into your own mines. 😅[/p][/*][/list][p]   
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45556311/26797848518af633712c33bdf4c8ff1cf6387f44.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2][b]GADGETS[/b] (AND GIZMOS APLENTY)[/h2][p][/p][p]Whether you're boarding, floating, or holding down the fort, a good handheld [b]gadget[/b] can swing the tide of any battle! [/p][p][/p][p]Gadgets are perfect for diving overboard, last-minute loot grabs, or causing minor diplomatic incidents, so be sure to use them "responsibly." Or don’t—we’re not your parents! In fact, the more creative the use....the better.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45556311/5aa2588d29bc125f18581a1db01a4a9e07a0e9ee.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Here are some examples of gadgets you can find:[/p][p][/p][list][*][p][b]TRACTOR BEAMS[/b] pull in loot, Artifacts, or even whole ships from a big distance.
[/p][/*][*][p]The [b]STAR LANCE[/b] is a high-impact beam that melts shields and hulls in one shot—even piercing two items (or prospectors) at once!
[/p][/*][*][p][b]CLAMP JETS[/b] provide a powerful, though temporary speed boost to whatever object they're attached to.  Whether it’s your own ship or an enemy ship, choose wisely! (Rumor has it they also work on prospectors.)  [/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45556311/26797848518af633712c33bdf4c8ff1cf6387f44.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2][b]EMBRACE THE CHAOS [/b][/h2][p]
Finding and combining loot in Wildgate isn't always just about what's best; it's also about what's fun! And whether you want to fight at range, fight close up, or try not to fight at all, the Reach is both your battlefield and your playground here. [/p][p][/p][p]There's so many possibilities: A [b]Shock Field[/b] and [b]Laser Ram[/b] turn your ship into a close-range deathtrap. A [b]Sniper Cannon[/b] with a [b]Probe Sensor[/b] give you long range vision and precision. How about some [b]Mine Layers[/b] and a [b]Tractor Beam[/b]? Pull'm up and knock'm down.[/p][p] [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45556311/6493aad88a3fd079bf157a9f84838bbf8ffd3137.jpg"][/img]  [/p][p]While your loot room drops are as random as the Reach itself, a real prospector makes their own luck. So don't just wait for good things to find you when there's four other ships out there to pillage with doors that open! [/p][p][/p][p](You see it → you like it → you want it → you steal it.)[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45556311/658ae01135e1be4c00e929101c17700dbd8ddb25.png"][/img][/p][p]
Wildgate’s loot is big, bold, and begging to be used in creative ways. So, pick something ridiculous, push some buttons, and see what happens. Don't like what happens? Find some more loot and fly, fly again. (Worst case: You get a big laugh and someone else gets a great replay out of it!)[/p][p][/p][p]---[/p][p][/p][p][b]Wildgate launches July 22[/b]: [url="https://wildgate.gg/wishlist"]https://wildgate.gg/wishlist[/url][/p][p][b]Join our Discord[/b]: [url="https://discord.gg/playwildgate"]https://discord.gg/playwildgate[/url] [/p][p][b]Subscribe to our YouTube channel[/b]: [dynamiclink href="https://www.youtube.com/@playwildgate"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: CHARTING THE REACH: The Lore of Wildgate
notes.notes:
[p]Every universe has a beginning, and not always a neat one![/p][p]
In the early days of "Project Nebula" (our codename for Wildgate), we weren’t trying to write a space bible. Well, not immediately, anyway. There was something a lot more pressing for our team to answer:[/p][p][b]
Why would anyone choose to go into a dangerous place like the Reach?[/b][/p][p]
The Reach isn’t just some cool backdrop for exploding ships (though it is absolutely that, too). It’s the cornerstone upon which Wildgate’s entire world was created—from the prospectors that explore it to the ancient civilizations whose artifacts they now hunt...and all the untold stories in between.[/p][p] [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45556311/38ca3ed1bcb8a2ba11f3942e370e40a12682fb5c.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45556311/580509c1983e19fd8a8f661163c4cd7d024be236.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45556311/38ca3ed1bcb8a2ba11f3942e370e40a12682fb5c.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]In this edition of [b]CHARTING THE REACH[/b], we sat down with our game director, Dustin Browder, to learn a bit more about the lore of Wildgate, including a brief history of the Reach as well as some recent events that have caused this particular sector of the galaxy to become such a hot spot for adventure. [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45556311/658ae01135e1be4c00e929101c17700dbd8ddb25.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2][b]THE TYPHON REACH[/b][/h2][p]
The Typhon Reach (or simply "the Reach" to veteran prospectors) is the setting of every match you play and story you create in Wildgate. And it's exuded Main Character Energy right from the start.[/p][p]
Whether you’re watching an ascending rocket break Earth’s upper atmosphere or a team of astronauts on an EVA take their first step into a vaccum-filled void, the idea of space can send chills of awe and wonder down your spine. We always knew we wanted the Reach (and Wildgate itself) to be similarly beautiful and inspiring, as well as a little deadly.[/p][p][/p][quote][p][i]“We wanted it to feel dangerous and unknowable. This is the sea before we knew the boundaries. This is the sea when there were still dragons at the edge of the map.”[/i] - Dustin[/p][/quote][p][/p][p]For our prospectors, knowledge of the Reach stretches back hundreds of years. When the first space-faring civilizations discovered it, a smattering of small mining and science bases were established on its edge. Various expeditions set out from these settlements with the aim of charting the Reach, with most completely vanishing without a trace.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45556311/38ca3ed1bcb8a2ba11f3942e370e40a12682fb5c.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45556311/f6d417d7f20570ade4c34cd8fcaee1e061ae15dc.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45556311/38ca3ed1bcb8a2ba11f3942e370e40a12682fb5c.png"][/img]  [/p][p][/p][p]After a time, and whether by their skill or sheer luck, a few stragglers started to return from their voyages. Sitting at bars, these suriving crews drank and told tales of ancient monuments, abandoned spaceships, technology beyond understanding, and valuable exotic resources in huge quantities. [/p][p]
It's from these early stories that the legend of the Reach began to grow... [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45556311/658ae01135e1be4c00e929101c17700dbd8ddb25.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2][b]THE 100-YEAR WAR[/b][/h2][p]
In the world of Wildgate,[b] [/b]the[b] Accord[/b] is one the largest governing bodies, ruling over a quarter of the known galaxy. An alliance of many different species and civilizations—including former rivals —the Accord brought together a melting-pot of cultures in the shared pursuits of support, protection, and exploration. This unusual family held together and expanded peacefully for many years…until they encountered the [b]First-Born[/b].[/p][p]
An ancient race, the First-Born proudly believed themselves to be the oldest empire in the universe, persevering through nearly 50 million years of rises, falls, in-fighting, and starting again from nothing. In spite of their storied past, vast periods of First-Born history have been lost to time due to their lack of interest in either anthropology or record-keeping.[/p][p]
In their most recent cycle of ascendancy and expansion, the First-Born confronted the Accord, and decided to conquer them. Arrogant, aloof, and cruel, their aggression marked the start of over a century of brutal and total war. This multi-system-spanning conflict has only recently concluded, and is very fresh in the minds of all our prospectors.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45556311/38ca3ed1bcb8a2ba11f3942e370e40a12682fb5c.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45556311/50279fc50407adfb31f507b40b84176c28fa3520.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45556311/38ca3ed1bcb8a2ba11f3942e370e40a12682fb5c.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]While the First-Born had huge technological advantages over the Accord, and initially forced them into a defensive war of survival, they were not infallible...and they had certain tells. After studying First-Born society, history, and actions in battle for many years, Accord xeno-anthropologists began to notice patterns in both their tactics and thinking.[/p][p]
For example: When faced with a challenge, the First-Born would continuously commit forces to a campaign until resistance was completely wiped out. It didn't matter if they had technically won the engagement, a clear and decisive victory was imperative to First-Born leadership, regardless of the cost. This led the Accord to adapt their tactics to exploit such rigidity. Sent on what was often a one-way-trip, new Vanguard units (of which Ion was a member) engaged in long-term guerrilla warfare with the First-Born. Drawing massive enemy deployments away from key battles through sustained hit-and-run action, the Vanguard kept the Accord in the war long enough to eventually triumph.[/p][p][/p][quote][p][i]“It wasn’t the railguns that beat the First-Born, it was that the First-Born were too predictable in how they behaved. And that’s ultimately what allowed the Accord to survive this incredible danger—their willingness to learn and to understand their enemy.”[/i] - Dustin[/p][/quote][p] 
Even during the war, both sides still ventured into the Reach in search of rumoured relics they felt could turn the tide. And based on ongoing discoveries from these expeditions, Accord historians soon realized that, contrary to their aeons-long belief, the First-Born were not, in fact, the first.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45556311/658ae01135e1be4c00e929101c17700dbd8ddb25.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2][b]ONCE MORE UNTO THE REACH...[/b][/h2][p]
During past Reach exploration, evidence of unusual buildings, technology, and devices from another distinct, mysterious, and highly-advanced precursor to the First-Born had already started to surface. Now, thanks to the analysis of the Accord's scientists, it's theorized that these [b]"Primes"[/b] (a name given them by said scientists) had already vanished from the galaxy millions of years before any other species had even discovered space flight.[/p][p]
As a result, when the Accord eventually emerged triumphant following a final, daring attack on the First-Born homeworld, their battered and bruised citizens looked once more to the Reach—and to the remnants of the Primes—for answers. The war had nearly taken everything from them, leaving entire planets stripped of resources (or in smouldering ruins) and large amounts of displaced people desperate to rebuild and start their lives anew. Could the Reach and its secrets help the Accord and new Free Colonies recover from the damage the First-Born had wrought? [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45556311/38ca3ed1bcb8a2ba11f3942e370e40a12682fb5c.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45556311/e5c908a7c5b6822dd78f423f6d0d021600bfacd2.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45556311/38ca3ed1bcb8a2ba11f3942e370e40a12682fb5c.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]As the dust of war settles, a new chapter in this enigmatic part of universe begins—and waves of prospectors set course for its horizon. Some seek glory, some adventure, while others search for things they've lost...or hope for a brighter future.[/p][p]
Whatever the motivation, all roads lead to one destination... [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45556311/658ae01135e1be4c00e929101c17700dbd8ddb25.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]Wildgate launches July 22[/b]: [url="https://wildgate.gg/wishlist"]https://wildgate.gg/wishlist[/url]
[b]Join our Discord[/b]: [url="https://discord.gg/playwildgate"]https://discord.gg/playwildgate[/url]
[b]Subscribe to our YouTube channel[/b]: [dynamiclink href="https://www.youtube.com/@playwildgate"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: Wildgate Global Launch Times
notes.notes:
[h3][i]🚨  LUCKY DOCKS HANGAR OPENING... PLEASE STAND BY  🚨[/i][/h3][p][/p][p]Pre-flight checks nearly complete... ✔️
Shields up... ✔️
Prepare to jump... ✔️[/p][p][/p][p]Wildgate officially releases on [b]Tuesday,[/b] [b]July 22 [/b]at [b]8:00am PDT[/b]![/p][p][/p][h2][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45556311/658ae01135e1be4c00e929101c17700dbd8ddb25.png"][/img][/h2][h2][b]LOCALIZED LAUNCH TIMES[/b][/h2][p]
Our current plan is for Wildgate to launch across all supported platforms at the same time around the world. To find out when Wildgate will be available in your region, check out the guides below.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45556311/e7c3630ffcfacba97d6da63455512ff0d6d16ff9.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45556311/26797848518af633712c33bdf4c8ff1cf6387f44.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][table equalcells="1" colwidth=",344"][tr][th][p]- CITY -[/p][/th][th colwidth="344"][p][b]- LAUNCH TIME (LOCAL) -[/b][/p][/th][/tr][tr][td][p][b]Los Angeles[/b][/p][/td][td colwidth="344"][p]July 22 @ 08:00 AM PDT[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]Mexico City[/b][/p][/td][td colwidth="344"][p]July 22 @ 09:00 AM CST[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]Chicago[/b][/p][/td][td colwidth="344"][p]July 22 @ 10:00 AM CDT[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]New York[/b][/p][/td][td colwidth="344"][p]July 22 @ 11:00 AM EDT[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]São Paulo[/b][/p][/td][td colwidth="344"][p]July 22 @ 12:00 PM BRT[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]London[/b][/p][/td][td colwidth="344"][p]July 22 @ 16:00 PM BST[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]Paris / Berlin / Johannesburg[/b][/p][/td][td colwidth="344"][p]July 22 @ 17:00 PM CEST / SAST[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]Seoul[/b][/p][/td][td colwidth="344"][p]July 23 @ 00:00 AM KST[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]Tokyo[/b][/p][/td][td colwidth="344"][p]July 23 @ 00:00 AM JST[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]Sydney[/b][/p][/td][td colwidth="344"][p]July 23 @ 01:00 AM AEST[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]Auckland[/b][/p][/td][td colwidth="344"][p]July 23 @ 03:00 AM NZST[/p][/td][/tr][/table][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45556311/658ae01135e1be4c00e929101c17700dbd8ddb25.png"][/img][/p][h2][b]
LAUNCH TIME FAQ[/b][/h2][p][/p][p][b]Q. What is Wildgate’s launch date and time?
[/b]A. Wildgate launches July 22 at 8:00am PDT[b].[/b]
[/p][p][b]Q. Can I pre-purchase Wildgate?
[/b]A. No. Wildgate will not be available for pre-purchase. As a result, you will only be able to purchase and start playing [i]after[/i] 8:00am PDT on July 22.[/p][p][b]
Q. Can I pre-download Wildgate before it launches?
[/b]A. No. Since Wildgate is a premium game (but is not available for pre-purchase), pre-downloads will not be available. Thankfully, our client is fairly small, coming in at right around 9gb![/p][p][b]
Q. Can I wishlist Wildgate?
[/b]A. Absolutely! Wishlisting will not only ensure that you're notified the moment Wildgate opens, but it's also a great way to support the game and help us grow this community into an unstoppable crew.[/p][p][b]
Q. How much will Wildgate cost?[/b]
A. Wildgate will be available for $29.99 USD (though pricing may vary slightly by region).[/p][p][b]
Q. Will additional editions of Wildgate be available for purchase?
[/b]A. Yes! Players will have the option to purchase the [url="https://playwildgate.com/en-US/news/renegade-edition/"]Wildgate - Renegade Edition[/url], which includes the full digital game plus a unique bundle of themed outfits and styles for your prospectors and ships.[/p][p]

A. North America, South America, Europe, and APAC.[/p][p][b]
